safetyConstraints.measurement: Use a food thermometer in the thickest edible portion away from bone; culinary tenderness temperatures are not safety minima.
safetyConstraints.sourceConflictPolicy: Official safe handling controls override creator advice about long ambient rests or unmeasured cooler holds. Injected or otherwise altered products require applicable product-specific handling; no universal process validation is claimed.

heat_source_fuel.decisionNote: Keep charcoal/wood, pellet and electric-smoker branches separate.

direct_vs_indirect_heat.decisionNote: Smoking/indirect grilling is the detailed branch; Myron supplies only a lower-resolution grilling reference.

heat_intensity.decisionNote: Tuffy uses 275F; Heath and Elite use 300F. Do not assign either value to the lower-resolution sources.

time_endpoint.decisionNote: Clean bite and probe/skewer tenderness are culinary targets. Time is not a safety test; do not impose one universal rib clock.

brine_salt_level_duration.decisionNote: Elite documents injection; no common salt concentration or duration is established.

marinade_duration.decisionNote: No cross-source marinade duration is asserted.

sweetness.decisionNote: Detailed competition branches use sweet wrap or glaze components; quantities are source-specific and are not averaged.

acidity.decisionNote: Tuffy adds vinegar to sauce; Elite uses an acidic wrap component. No common acidity target is inferred.

spice_heat.decisionNote: Seasoning and spicy accents remain optional source-specific flavor choices.

smoke_intensity.decisionNote: Use the selected cooker/fuel branch; no numeric smoke-dose scale is supported.

glaze_sauce_timing.decisionNote: Detailed competition sources apply a late sauce/glaze finish after tenderizing. Exact setting times remain method-specific.

resting_finishing.decisionNote: Elite documents a rest; do not export a universal ambient hold. Official temperature/time controls govern.

synthesis.completionBasis: Five distinct qualified method/practitioner lineages; supported branches and unknown axes explicit; independent official safety constraints. Extra qualified references do not add votes.
agreements: Use source-specific equipment and texture checks rather than a universal cook time.
Separate culinary tenderness and flavor from official safety controls.
disagreements: Preserve different cooker, wrapping and cut branches; do not average incompatible methods.
limitations: Low-resolution sources do not support numerical stages.
No Spanish-authenticity, safety-process certification, public application or Knowledge Core promotion is implied.
